remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [note of backing inscription 1]. Stretcher inscription 1 dates 1919, which may indicate when work was begun. Stretcher inscription 2 dates 1921 and indicates no. 53 in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Backing inscription 1 dates 1920. O'Keeffe dates 1920 on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 12. Titled *The Red Maple Lake George* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription 1, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: The Red Maple, Lake George

description: Organic, leaf-like forms in shades of orange and red run diagonally across this abstract composition. Blue forms that resemble tree limbs twist and curl behind the leaves. The background of the work is painted in varying, vibrant shades of green.
title: The Red Maple, Lake George
